rules_note: Final amendment ~2026-09-30: Believer wins unless BOTH labs are Out of Business by the deadline (one-lab OOB → Believer). Skeptic wins only on dual OOB. Ch.11 still counts as OOB for a lab. No-bet is mainly dual carve-outs / both legs voided — not single failure.
